name: Bayview Rehabilitation & Nursing
description: Mid-size urban SNF, 140 beds, short-stay rehab focus with moderate clinical acuity. No vent or trach unit, no secured unit.

emergencyKit.description: Limited. No insulin analogs, no DOAC, no ARNI

name: Harborview Post-Acute & Pulmonary
description: High-acuity post-acute, 200 beds, with a 24-bed ventilator and tracheostomy unit and four in-house dialysis chairs. Stricter about documentation before the patient is in the building.
formularyContract: 01/2026 to 12/2026, broad, includes ARNI, SGLT2 and DOAC

emergencyKit.description: Broad. Insulin analogs, DOAC, IV antibiotics

name: Maple Grove Skilled Nursing
description: Smaller suburban facility, 90 beds, long-term care heavy, with a 20-bed secured memory care unit. Limited medical acuity, narrow formulary, pharmacy 40 minutes away with an early cutoff.
formularyContract: 01/2026 to 12/2026, narrow, exceptions take 72 to 96 hours

emergencyKit.description: Minimal. Oral analgesics and antiemetics only
